The user supplies the local service or"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" existing Python/project/model configuration; the plugin sends one natural sentence per request and "},{"id":"p4s4","text":"plays the returned audio."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Based on 1624318455/dsh-plugin-tts, commit `ec0cf87ef52abb81ae91681a966aa3096365e631`. Its message b"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"uttons, Auto Read toggle, Edge/RVC providers, pause/stop controls, settings and Harness API integrat"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ion are reused. See NOTICE."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**This is a connector and process launcher, not a model distribution.** It does not install, trim, r"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"etrain or modify TTS models. It uses an existing environment for bundled SDK loading recipes or a wo"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"rker command that you configure. No checkpoints, reference recordings, voice caches, Python environm"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ents or generated audio are included."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Model folders and bilingual settings"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Universal local TTS (release candidate)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Requirements and support"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Harness 0.1 (from `0.1.0-rc.6`, including `0.1.1-rc.2`) and 0.2 (from `0.2.0-rc.2`) share one plugin"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" package. Compatibility uses public services and message selectors; 0.1 Session chunks and 0.2 Agent"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" stream frames feed the same sentence player. The peer range retains an upper bound at the next mino"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"r family. Future breaking interfaces need validation before expanding it. See validation boundaries."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness web profile with `webServer`, `session/event` and client UI slots. Node.js 22+ an"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"d a browser with Web Audio.\n- A compatible local HTTP service, or an existing model installation wit"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"h a worker implementing the JSONL worker protocol.\n- The built-in IndexTTS / GPT-SoVITS launchers ne"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ed the existing Python environment, project and model files. Thin examples in `adapters/` contain no"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"isting Python environment, project and model files. Thin examples in `adapters/` contain no weights."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The plugin discovers known paths only inside the selected local project/wrapper folder. It does not "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"scan whole disks, install dependencies or open WebUI pages. Detected and manually configured paths a"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"re kept in browser settings. IndexTTS and GPT-SoVITS retain separate project/model/voice profiles, s"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"o switching back restores that engine's previous paths without copying them into the other engine."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**This plugin can be installed and enabled alongside the original.** Its package, routes, settings a"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"nd UI identifiers are independent. Detection of the original automatically enables Local companion m"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"rs are independent. Detection of the original automatically enables Local companion mode; see below."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Updates and compatibility"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The settings page checks this repository's completed GitHub releases at most once per day when opene"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"d. It labels release candidates and supports a manual refresh. Checks send no credentials or convers"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ation text to GitHub; offline/rate-limit errors remain visible and can be retried. Automatic checkin"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ub; offline/rate-limit errors remain visible and can be retried. Automatic checking can be disabled."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Install update** requires confirmation and delegates to the installed DSH Market's update/restore "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"operation. The market retains its running-agent guard, host compatibility validation and rollback. R"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"estart Harness and refresh after installation; the loaded module does not pretend to change before r"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"estart. Local `file:` installations can restore to the catalog source after this repository is liste"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"d. Without the market, with a fixed release URL, or before catalog publication, use the displayed Gi"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"tHub installation command (replace `web` for a custom profile). The plugin never independently repla"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"ces its own files or grants compatibility exemptions."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"If a host rejects the plugin before activation, its own update panel cannot run; use the independent"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" market or CLI. Known Chat/Session message projections are detected by capability, with an explicit "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"warning for unsupported shapes. Durable final-message reading remains available when transient frame"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"s are absent, although speech then starts after the reply completes. CI checks actual official 0.1.1"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"-rc.2 / 0.2.0-rc.2 host packages and the moving `alpha` channel on each push. These checks detect co"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ntract changes; they cannot automatically adapt an arbitrary future API or replace real model/browse"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"r acceptance. The 0.3 boundary remains closed."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Legacy HTTP compatibility"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Previously saved HTTP configurations remain supported internally. They are not the normal setup flow"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" and do not start the external HTTP service. Its API base URL is not a project folder or WebUI URL; "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"see the exact legacy HTTP contract. Changing the project folder returns to the built-in process laun"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"he exact legacy HTTP contract. Changing the project folder returns to the built-in process launcher."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Privacy and security"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Local mode sends assistant text only from the Harness Host to the configured Runtime. It never reads"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" Harness login credentials. Loopback `127.0.0.1` and `localhost` are allowed by default; localhost D"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"NS is pinned to IPv4 loopback. LAN consent displays a warning because text leaves the machine. There"},{"id":"p26s4","text":" are no automatic cloud fallbacks; this fork's inherited cloud approval announcements are disabled i"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"n Local Runtime mode. The original plugin's own cloud features are independent: disable them yoursel"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"f if all speech must remain local."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Regular logs do not contain complete reply text. **Debug** explicitly enables sentence text logging;"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" keep it off for private conversations. Local text/audio queues are in memory, bounded and released "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"on playback acknowledgement, cancellation or expiry. The IndexTTS worker uses a temporary WAV during"},{"id":"p27s4","text":" synthesis and deletes it after returning; abnormal termination may leave a temporary file. Your Run"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"time and Harness have their own logging, caching and download behavior."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Edge TTS sends text to Microsoft. RVC can use Edge TTS for base speech before local conversion. Thes"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"e inherited providers have separate privacy characteristics; choosing them is not equivalent to full"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"y local synthesis. Existing upstream RVC file/voice-pack tooling is unchanged and is intended for a "},{"id":"p28s4","text":"trusted, locally operated Harness. Do not expose the Harness/plugin to untrusted users or the public"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"ocally operated Harness.
